title: CO emission tracing a warp or radial flow within ≲100 au in the HD 100546 protoplanetary disk
question: Does the 12CO J=3-2 velocity field of the HD 100546 disk deviate from Keplerian rotation, indicating an inner-disk warp or radial flow?

evidence.quote: a stellar mass of $2.4 M_{\odot}$, (cite: vandenancker98)

what.value: Outer disk P.A. 146+-4 deg and inclination 44+-3 deg from continuum

evidence.quote: a P.A. of $146\degree \pm 4\degree$ and an inclination of $44\degree \pm 3\degree$ (cite: pineda14)

what.value: CO emitting layer opening angle ~11 deg from thermo-chemical modelling

recipe.goal: Re-image 12CO cube and make moment maps
recipe.method: Re-clean with uniform weighting; zeroth moment 3 sigma clip, first/second/eighth 6 sigma clip

recipe.goal: Fit flat and flared Keplerian surface to first-moment map
recipe.method: Analytic line-of-sight velocity model convolved with the beam; grid search over inclination, P.A. and opening angle (coarse 5 deg then 1 deg)
key_parameters: Inclination 20-60 deg, P.A. 120-170 deg, opening angle 0-20 deg
assumptions: Stellar mass 2.4 Msun; Keplerian rotation; emission from flat or double-cone surface

recipe.method: Outer disk fixed to best upper-cone model; inner flat disk with own inclination, P.A. and transition radius; coarse grid 10 deg/10 au then 2 deg/2 au
key_parameters: inner inclination 40-90 deg, inner P.A. 40-100 deg, transition radius 40-120 au
assumptions: Inner disk planar and flat Keplerian

recipe.method: Radial velocity v_r = chi v_K inside a transition radius, flat disk inside; coarse grid 10 au/0.1 then 1 au/0.01
key_parameters: transition radius 10-120 au; chi 0 to sqrt(2)
assumptions: Outer disk fixed to best upper-cone model

recipe.method: Scaling relation from Lai 2014 / Debes 2017 for assumed companions
key_parameters: mu_c = 0.006, r_disk = 40 au, a_c = 50 au, i_c = 80 deg

answer_key.quantity: Best-fit flat disk inclination / P.A. (metric i)
Best upper-cone flared model inclination / P.A. / opening angle

evidence.quote: The best-fit inclination, P.A., and opening angle are 36, 145, and 9, respectively

answer_key.quantity: Best warp model (metric i): inner inclination, P.A., transition radius

answer_key.value: 84 deg, 64 deg, 100 au; peak residual 2.44 dv

answer_key.quantity: Radial flow best fit (metric i): transition radius, chi

evidence.quote: Metric (i) favours a radial component to the flow within a radius of 54 au and a velocity scaling factor of $\chi = 1.23$ which is close to the free-fall velocity.

answer_key.quantity: Warp precession period for companion at 50 au

evidence.quote: results in a precession period of 1940 yr

answer_key.quantity: Warp precession period for companion at 10 au

evidence.quote: leads to a precession period of 111 yr
